data.description: Define the Dreamlining event product through client dialogue: problem framing, fairness mechanics, facilitator and participant journeys, scope, philosophy, and acceptance-criteria-backed user stories. No implementation until UX is explicitly solidified.
data.title: Initiate Dreamlining participant UX

data.body: Planning found an untouched Next.js starter and no existing Tone/product artifacts. The plan now sequences commission, cited problem/landscape/fairness research, client-led refinement of facilitator and participant wireflows, a precise but still undecided fairness policy, philosophy and AC-ID user stories, and an explicit client approval gate before prototype work. It excludes app code, technical architecture, and binding visual decisions.

Need: client decision on whether the structured feedback phase enforces balanced reviewer assignments before opening free exploration, or only recommends under-reviewed participants while allowing free browsing throughout.
